One-line description: AI-planned family trips with local guides, taxis and stays.
Prior startup experience: Manish has run a family business. Kavya has none.
What have you built?: A web app where families answer 6 questions and receive an AI-drafted itinerary. The itinerary uses a language model and 40 hand-built route templates. Bookings are confirmed manually on WhatsApp.
Customers: 410 bookings since launch, covering about 1,300 travellers.
Revenue: Total booking value INR 38.6 L. We earn a 12% commission, so revenue is INR 4.6 L.
Repeat: 14% of families have booked a second trip.
Customer acquisition: Referrals from Manish's earlier agency customers and Instagram. Paid acquisition is about INR 640 per booking.
Key risks: Quality of local partners, seasonality and manual operations that do not yet scale.
Anything else we should know?: We are passionate about travel and would love to tell you more on a call.
Founder background: Manish Joshi: 10 years running his family's travel agency in Jaipur, which has served over 3,000 families. Kavya Nair: 3 years as a web developer.
